## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The release approval boundary should be fixed because it rejects releases that have exactly the required number of approvals.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- zzz-release/gate.py:5 — correctness — `approved(2, minimum=2)` now returns `False`, rejecting a release that meets the configured minimum. The module contract says “at least the configured number,” but `>` excludes equality. Restore `>=` and add an equality regression test; the existing tests exercise only counts above and below the minimum. — Releases meeting the approval requirement are blocked until an unnecessary additional approval arrives.
